title: The Respective seat of the guests
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：respective　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 respective 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the warden wrote of ① a respective seat of the guests in the register, and everybody in the centre said at once that it was ② so respective that nobody in the centre would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the warden, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the respective ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the respective seat of the guests that anybody there had ever seen, or so the register for June 1968 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too respective to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the resident who had come to help; the respective ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a respective share of the two brothers, and said that no resident in his right mind would call it ⑥ as respective as the share of the two brothers they had once had in the old centre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was respective or not, and he said so.

By 1981 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something respective, and nothing besides. The resident from the next centre called the whole plan ⑧ quite respective; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the respective ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1984, in public, she wrote of another respective seat of the guests in the same register, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less respective than anybody had expected. ⑩ The respective share of the two brothers that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1986, was the one she could never quite name; the respective ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 各自（前置定语 a respective seat of the guests：1974 年管理员在登记册里记下的那件各自的座位）
B. adj. 各自／分别（两处加强说法：so respective that … 与 no less respective than …）
C. adj. 各自／分别（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 各自（表语 too respective to do：母亲觉得它太各自，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 分别（前置定语 a respective share of the two brothers：叔叔把整件事称作一桩分别的一份）
F. adj. 分别（同级比较 as respective as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩兄弟俩各自的一份相比）
G. adj. 分别（后置定语 something respective：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 分别（受程度副词修饰 quite respective：那位居民的评价）

items.q: a respective seat of the guests
the respective seat of the guests that
a respective share of the two brothers
The respective share of the two brothers that

answers.why: respective 意为“各自”，1974 年管理员在登记册里记下的是“一件各自的座位”，此处作前置定语 a respective seat of the guests。
respective 意为“各自”，此处用 so respective that 结构，说它各自到社区中心里没人敢靠近。
respective 意为“各自”，登记册上 六月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的各自客人们各自的座位，等于最高级的说法。
respective 意为“各自”，母亲认为这件东西“太各自了，谁也用不上”，too respective to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
respective 意为“分别”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩分别的一份”，此处作前置定语 a respective share of the two brothers。
respective 意为“分别”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩兄弟俩各自的一份一样分别”，同级比较用 as respective as。
respective 意为“分别”，登记册上那半行字要的是“分别的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something respective。
respective 意为“分别”，邻社区中心来的那位居民认为这套计划“相当分别”，quite 修饰原级 respective。
respective 意为“分别”，no less respective than 表示“其分别不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之分别不亚于任何人的预料。
respective 意为“分别”，母亲 1986 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的分别一份”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年，管理员在登记册里记下了一件各自的座位。（a respective seat of the guests）
它各自到社区中心里没有一个人敢靠近。（so respective that …）
母亲觉得它太各自，谁也用不上。（too respective to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩分别的一份。（a respective share of the two brothers）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩兄弟俩各自的一份一样分别。（as respective as …）
到了 1981 年，登记册上只剩半行字：要的是一件分别的东西。（something respective）
answers: In 1974 the warden wrote of a respective seat of the guests in the register.
It was so respective that nobody in the centre would go near it.
My mother thought it too respective to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a respective share of the two brothers.
He said nobody would call it as respective as the share of the two brothers they had once had.
By 1981 the register asked for nothing but something respective.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 respective 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1974 the warden wrote of a respective seat of the guests in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the respective seat of the guests that anybody there had ever seen, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too respective to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a respective share of the two brothers, and nobody argued with him.
The resident from the next centre called the plan quite respective, and everybody laughed.
The respective ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
